meta.name: deliverability-qa
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "run a deliverability pre-flight before I send", "check my SPF/DKIM/DMARC/BIMI", "why am I landing in spam / promotions", or "score my sender reputation and list hygiene"; runs the ONE-TIME pre-send SEND S1 authentication pre-flight and scores the SEND S (Sender-integrity / Deliverability) dimension — a DNS + DMARC-RUA auth check, domain/IP reputation read, inbox-placement (seed-list) result, a spam-content/link/render scan, and a point-in-time bounce/complaint list-hygiene snapshot — with per-sub-item pass/partial/needs-input notes and an S1 status flag. Not for the recurring hygiene / bounce-complaint trend read over time — use list-hygiene-monitor; not for computing the final EQS or enforcing the vetoes — use email-quality-auditor; not for building segments/suppression lists — use list-segment-builder. 邮件送达率预检/SPF DKIM DMARC认证/发件域声誉

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发送前检查邮件送达率与认证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发送邮件前验证SPF/DKIM/DMARC和发件人声誉。
copy.tagline_en: Check email deliverability and authentication before sending
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify SPF/DKIM/DMARC and sender reputation before sending emails.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查发件域的 SPF/DKIM/DMARC/BIMI 认证、域名/IP 声誉、收件箱放置情况、垃圾内容扫描和列表卫生快照，并给出 S1 认证状态标志和 SEND S 维度评分。
howto.when: 当你要求“发送前运行送达率预检”、“检查我的 SPF/DKIM/DMARC/BIMI”、“为什么邮件进了垃圾箱/促销标签”或“评估我的发件人声誉和列表卫生”时触发。

say.text: 在发送前为 example.com 运行送达率预检。
say.note: Claude 会执行一次完整的预检并生成报告。

say.text: 检查我的 SPF/DKIM/DMARC/BIMI 和退信率。
say.note: Claude 会检查认证记录和列表卫生。

say.text: 为什么我的邮件进了促销标签？这是收件箱放置测试结果。
say.note: Claude 会分析原因并给出 S1 标志。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude checks the sending domain's SPF/DKIM/DMARC/BIMI authentication, domain/IP reputation, inbox placement, spam content scan, and a point-in-time list hygiene snapshot, then outputs an S1 status flag and a SEND S dimension score.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "run a deliverability pre-flight before I send", "check my SPF/DKIM/DMARC/BIMI", "why am I landing in spam / promotions", or "score my sender reputation and list hygiene".

say_en.text: Run a deliverability pre-flight for example.com before I send.
say_en.note: Claude runs a full pre-flight and generates a report.

say_en.text: Check my SPF/DKIM/DMARC/BIMI and my bounce rate.
say_en.note: Claude checks authentication records and list hygiene.

say_en.text: Why am I hitting the Promotions tab? Here is my inbox-placement test.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the cause and flags S1 status.
